title: ResultSafe Core Executable Contract IR
summary: Strict executable intermediate representation of the Result algebra, public operations, TypeScript extensions, laws, identity, exceptions, compatibility, and projection applicability.

compatibility_policy.additive: A new optional projection or symbol that does not alter an existing entity is additive.
compatibility_policy.behavioral: A callback, branch, exception, identity, law, or projection-applicability change is behavioral and requires conformance review.
compatibility_policy.breaking: Removing or renaming a symbol, variant, required input, output member, or stable type assertion is breaking.

result.definition: Data-only transport algebra containing exactly one of SUCCESS<T> or FAILURE<E> and no behavior members.

runtime-result.definition: Methodful language projection of Result data; behavior is non-transport state and is restored only by explicit hydration.

result-like.definition: Boundary union of Result transport data and the runtime Result projection.

option.definition: Exactly one of SOME<T> or NONE.

async-validator-function.definition: TypeScript callable from unknown to Awaitable<boolean> with optional predicate evidence.

payload-keys.definition: Ordered configured payload keys inferred from a VariantConfig.

validator-function.definition: TypeScript runtime boolean predicate with optional type-predicate evidence.

variant-config.definition: Payload-key order, strict-own-field policy, and forbidden-own-field policy.

handler.definition: One discriminator key and its branch-narrowed callback.

match-builder.definition: Exhaustive matcher builder whose run member exists only when no variants remain.

matcher.definition: Ordered matcher builder completed by an unmatched-input fallback.

sync-refined-result.definition: Selected variant with fields established by synchronous validators.

sync-refined-result-union.definition: Distributive union of all synchronously refined configured variants.

sync-validator-map.definition: Own variant keys map to own payload keys and synchronous validators.

universal-async-refined-result.definition: Async-refined variant limited to runtime-established field evidence.

universal-refined-result.definition: Synchronously refined variant limited to runtime-established field evidence.

variant-of.definition: Distributive tagged object union for each discriminator in K.
